# glean

> Self-hosted, pluggable personal agent that gleans signal from RSS, scraping, and search — processes via any LLM, fans out to Telegram/Discord/Slack/ntfy/Webhook/File.

## Essential reading

- [Concepts: What is a feed](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/concepts/feed/): The core mental model
- [Quickstart](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/getting-started/quickstart/): 5-minute first-run
- [Tutorial: AI news with Ollama](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/tutorials/ai-news-ollama/): 20-minute end-to-end walkthrough
- [feeds.yaml reference](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/config/feeds/): Complete config schema

## Reference

- [CLI](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/reference/cli/): All glean subcommands
- [REST API](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/reference/api/): Live Swagger UI
- [JSON Schema](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/reference/feeds-schema.json): For IDE/agent validation
- [Plugin protocols](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/plugins/): Source / Sink / LLM / Search

## Operations

- [Security model](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/operations/security/): Threat model + hardening
- [Troubleshooting](https://jaypetez.github.io/glean/operations/troubleshooting/): Symptom-cause-resolution
